top_signals.title: BP Eyes Bigger U.S. Shale Footprint After Devon Deal Talks
top_signals.summary: BP has started looking seriously at U.S. shale assets again, including Devon Energy’s Eagle Ford business, as CEO Meg O’Neill pushes the company back toward oil and gas growth. BP entered the data room for Devon’s South Texas assets after it opened in late August, according to Reuters sources. One source said BP ultimately walked away from a deal.
